string.name: privacy_permission_body
string.value: Mianyu reads steps, resting heart rate, and sleep (including the latest sleep stages) to show health summaries, 7-day trends, sleep details, and an on-device score. It is not used for anything else.

string.name: privacy_scope_steps
string.value: Steps: today and daily totals for the last 7 days

string.name: privacy_scope_heart
string.value: Resting heart rate: daily values for the last 7 days

string.name: privacy_scope_sleep
string.value: Sleep: duration and score for 7 days, plus the latest deep/light/REM/awake stages

string.name: privacy_boundary_readonly
string.value: Read only: Mianyu never writes or deletes health data

string.name: privacy_boundary_local
string.value: Data stays on this device; health details are never uploaded

string.name: privacy_boundary_backup
string.value: App data is excluded from system cloud backup and restore

string.name: privacy_boundary_sync
string.value: Any future cloud sync will be off by default and limited to an allowlist summary

string.name: privacy_revoke_body
string.value: You can revoke Mianyu’s Huawei Health access from Profile at any time. Reading stops immediately; existing on-device logs are unaffected.

string.name: privacy_disclaimer_body
string.value: Health data is for reference only and is not a medical diagnosis. For urgent symptoms, contact local emergency services immediately.

string.name: account_sync_subtitle
string.value: Allowlist summaries only; raw health data stays on-device

string.name: account_sync_switch_note
string.value: When enabled, allowlist summaries are synced to your HUAWEI Cloud. Raw health data and on-device details are never uploaded.

string.name: account_sync_whitelist
string.value: Current allowlist: sleep score, step summary, weekly resting heart-rate average. More fields will be added in future releases.
